class.name: GameplayTagContainer
class.brief_description: A set of hierarchical gameplay tags such as [code]Enemy.Infected.Elite[/code].
class.description: Equivalent of Unreal's Gameplay Tag Container. Tags are dot-separated strings. A non-exact query matches a tag when the query equals it or is one of its parents on a [code].[/code] boundary, so a container holding [code]Enemy.Infected.Elite[/code] reports [code]has_tag("Enemy")[/code] as [code]true[/code] but [code]has_tag("Ene")[/code] as [code]false[/code].

method.name: add_tag
method.description: Adds [param tag]. Empty tags and duplicates are ignored.

method.name: get_tag_count
method.description: Returns the number of stored tags.

method.name: has_all
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if every tag in [param tags] matches (see [method has_tag]). An empty array returns [code]true[/code].

method.name: has_any
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if at least one tag in [param tags] matches (see [method has_tag]).

method.name: has_tag
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a stored tag equals [param tag] or, when [param exact] is [code]false[/code], is a child of it.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the container holds no tags.

method.name: remove_tag
method.description: Removes the exactly equal [param tag], if present.

method.name: tag_matches
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param tag] equals [param query] or, when [param exact] is [code]false[/code], [param query] is a parent of [param tag] on a [code].[/code] boundary. Empty strings never match.
